newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: ALPINE SKIING-DUVILLARD HURT IN BIG TRAINING CRASH.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-DUVILLARD HURT IN BIG TRAINING CRASH.

text.p: French skier Adrien Duvillard suffered a serious accident in training on Friday for Saturday's World Cup downhill.
Duvillard lost control coming off the final jump into the finish area and crashed into the safety netting in almost the exact spot where Gernot Reinstadler of Austria was killed in 1991.
A helicopter was flown into the finish area and a medical team rushed to the French skier's aid.
Intravenous drips were hooked up and the area was cordoned off.
The extent of Duvillard's injuries were not immediately known. Training was halted after the accident.

The 27-year-old Duvillard, who has won one World Cup downhill in his career, is the nephew of Henri Duvillard who collected six World Cup victories between 1969 and 1973, including a win in the Wengen downhill.
